notes.subject: ol samting bilong kaikai bilong ol
notes.rationale: שלחנן literally 'tedbel' — ples bilong kaikai; Tok Pisin i gat no wanpela tok bilong tedbel

notes.subject: ולשלומים
notes.rationale: 'long ol man i stap gutpela' (JPS) o 'peman bilong ol' (ylt: shillum 'pe') — tupela mining i stap

translation: OL samting bilong kaikai bilong ol long holim han bilong ol i kamap net bilong ketchim ol, na long ol man i stap gutpela, em i kamap trep bilong ketchim ol.

tokens.gloss: ol samting bilong kaikai bilong ol
na long ol man i stap gutpela
